references.text: God promises to give rain in its season and that the earth will yield its produce, the same promise of blessing for obedience
The Lord will open his rich storehouse, the heavens, to give rain to the land in its season
Jeremiah reminds the people that God gives the autumn rain and the spring rain in their proper seasons and secures the weeks appointed for harvest
Joel prophesies that God will give the autumn rain and the spring rain, and that the threshing floors will be filled with grain and the winepresses will overflow with new wine and oil
An encouragement to pray to the Lord for rain in the season of the spring rains, for it is the Lord who sends the rain clouds
James uses the image of a farmer waiting for the precious fruit of the earth and for the autumn rain and the spring rain
Paul testifies that God has given rain from heaven and fruitful seasons, filling hearts with food and gladness
